conf.description: Cisco NX-OS interface-vpc-state / api-pull: reparse pipeline behind the REST Collector against /ins, recovering the standard Cisco header for facility-plus-code branching (LINK/LINEPROTO share UPDOWN, per direct.elastic) and running the identical UPDOWN/ETHPORT dissect and mnemonic-action lookup as the snmp-trap format, plus the embedded sequence number.

conf.comment: cisco-nxos / interface-vpc-state / api-pull. event.original arrives already populated by the REST Collector's TABLE_*/ROW_* walk. Recovers the %FACILITY-SEV-MNEMONIC: header (needed for facility-plus-code UPDOWN branching per direct.elastic) and the leading sequence number, then dissects the same LINK/LINEPROTO/ETHPORT shapes as the snmp-trap format. vPC/L2FM body grammar (domain number, MAC-move pair) is out of scope for the same reason as the snmp-trap format -- no sample given. observer.name/switch_name extraction is also skipped -- documented as a gap.

functions.description: document header/sequence recovery plus the shared UPDOWN/ETHPORT dissect and scope limits
recover the standard Cisco %FACILITY-SEV-MNEMONIC: header for facility-plus-code branching
dissect the LINK/LINEPROTO UPDOWN interface/line-protocol state-change shape
dissect the ETHPORT up/down shape and recover the parenthesised down reason
recover the embedded per-device sequence number when configured
map facility/code from the recovered header, interface name and down-reason from the branch match, derive event.action from the branch or a full mnemonic lookup, map the sequence number, drop temps
tag the event with its dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
